checks: Ten native store controls and seven reused pragmatic schema checks; see model.md#tests
cost: Strong snapshot hash/index pass each ingest; changed artifacts and indexed SQLite commits; status/export scale with selection and witness joins. No measured throughput improvement.
description: Transactional SQLite WAL annotation versions, explicit eligibility and immutable teacher/parser-bound exports.
forward: Content-bound seed/completed receipts -> serialized append-only versions and whole-pair selection -> consistent train/dev snapshots and same-revision actual-parser agreement inputs.
inverse: Behavior complement excludes invalid or heldout inputs from eligible selection and quarantines failed batches with lost-ID evidence.
Reverse reconstruction retains compatible receipt/version antecedents; export cannot reconstruct hidden teacher state or omitted history uniquely.
limitations: Trusted immutable source/phase evidence and SQLite/storage semantics assumed. No gold, generic power-loss, old-checkpoint or replay-safety proof. No percentage approximant admitted.
state: Separate historical file DB; stable first selection, retained conflicts, immutable eligibility identity; no teacher/GPU calls.
